content: docs#TwoSidedIdeal.mk was accidentally deprecated to... itself (it should have been to docs#TwoSidedIdeal.ofRingCon instead). Is there a way to catch this?
I have certainly made this mistake before, and it is probably easiest to address at the root: lean4#14333
Is it possible to also have a warning when the replacement is itself deprecated?
In principle, yes, but for boring reasons this is a slightly larger change, so you'll have to upvote lean4#14336.

Thanks! Is it not just checking Lean.Linter.isDeprecated env newName? followed by throwError?
IIUC what you wrote in the issue (I might not be), it's only difficult if we want to recommend a fix in the error message, right?
If so then I think the easy part is worth doing, so that we could fix these in mathlib

The problem is that you cannot check the value of the attribute while you are still in the process of declaring it. The isDeprecated function doesn't exist yet at that point. But this is really a boring code organization issue, nothing fundamental.
